entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I hope you can help. I need to... I need to return something. I've been a loyal customer for years and I just... I really need the money back right now.
I understand, and I'll certainly do my best to help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's... VF-881-92B. It was for a helmet. I just feel so bad about this, I was so excited for it.

Okay, I've got the order pulled up here. I see the helmet was delivered about 76 days ago. Can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, it's not broken. The box is unopened, I never even took it out. It's just... the color. It didn't look like the picture online and I've been putting off dealing with it. I feel terrible about waiting so long.

Not a problem at all. I see here that for this item, you're well within our 90-day return window. Since the box is still sealed, we can definitely process a full refund for you. Getting the right gear is important, especially when it comes to safety, so we want to make sure you're happy with your choice.
Oh! Really? Oh, thank you so much, David. That's a huge weight off my shoulders. I was so worried it would be a problem. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I've just emailed you a prepaid return shipping label. Just attach that to the package and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. You've been wonderful. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
